segs: In the Kiddush of Yom Tov we say,
"and He exalted us above every tongue,"
"and You exalted us above all the tongues";
but on Shabbos we do not say
the difference between the kedushah of Yom Tov
and the kedushah of Shabbos is
that the kedushah of Shabbos is
from the side of Hashem Yisbarach,
"to know that I am Hashem Who sanctifies you."
Whereas the kedushah of Yom Tov is
that it is Yisrael who fix it,
And this is the aspect of Torah she'b'al peh,
which comes from Yisrael's own exertion,
שֶׁנִּקְרְאָה אִשָּׁה יִרְאַת ה׳ (מִשְׁלֵי לא, ל),
and which is called "a woman who fears Hashem" (Mishlei 31:30),
and a Torah of kindness is on her tongue";
And just as the Torah was given in Lashon HaKodesh,
so too the world was created in Lashon HaKodesh,
And so it remained until the Generation of the Dispersion,
which was the time of the giving of Torah
the two thousand years of Torah.
And the world is called "the house of wine";
yayin has the numerical value of seventy,
like the number of the seventy nations.
And afterward they all turned to vinegar
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ בְּמִדְרָשׁ רַבָּה, בַּמִּדְבָּר ב, ג).
(as Chazal say in Midrash Rabbah, Bamidbar 2:3).
had words of Torah within them,
"And You give life to them all."
And this is what Chazal say (Eichah Rabbah 2:13):
"There is wisdom in Edom — believe it,
'And I will destroy the wise men from Edom.'"
Therefore the world is called "the house of wine,"
which alludes to Torah she'b'al peh.
And this is what is said in Midrash Rabbah (Bamidbar, ibid.):
אַחַר כָּךְ הֱבִיאַנִי אֶל בֵּית הַיָּיִן
Afterward: "He brought me to the house of wine"
לַמַּרְתֵּף הַגָּדוֹל שֶׁל יַיִן, זֶה סִינַי,
to the great cellar of wine: this is Sinai;
which is expounded in forty-nine facets,
And this refers to Torah she'b'al peh,
דְּתוֹרָה שֶׁבִּכְתָב לֹא שַׁיָּיךְ בָּהּ פָּנִים.
for facets do not apply to Torah she'b'chsav.
And the main revelation of Torah she'b'al peh
"and they transmitted it to the Men of the Great Assembly."
"Ezra came up from Bavel and re-established it," etc.;
"Hillel the Babylonian came up and re-established it," etc.
Therefore the Generation of the Dispersion sensed then
and they all turned to vinegar,
was awakened then by this change:
that the whole world had been of one language
and he was awakened by this to realize
that there is a Guide Who brings everything about.
וְזֶהוּ שֶׁאָמְרוּ (בְּרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה, נֹחַ ל, ח):
And this is what Chazal say (Bereishis Rabbah, Noach 30:8):
for that was the time of the Generation of the Dispersion,
and then only the words of Torah remained
regarding Rabbi Shimon ben Yochai, who said:
אִלּוּ הֲוֵינָא קָאֵים עַל טוּרָא דְּסִינַי,
"Had I been standing on Mount Sinai,
I would have requested of the Merciful One
that man be created with two mouths:
one that would toil in Torah," etc.;
for the tongue was created only for words of Torah.
שֶׁקִּיֵּים כׇּל הַתּוֹרָה עַד שֶׁלֹּא נִתְּנָה,
who fulfilled the entire Torah before it was given —
"And from where did he learn?" etc.
his two kidneys like two teachers,
and they would well forth and teach him
And this is Torah she'b'al peh:
that he originated the entire Torah
from his own heart and kidneys.
וְגַם שֶׁאַחַר כָּךְ יֵצְאוּ בִּרְכוּשׁ גָּדוֹל,
and also that "afterward they will go out with great wealth,"
was told to Avraham Avinu, alav hashalom —
in order to bring out the Torah and wisdom of the Oral Torah.
As is brought in the holy Zohar
'and with bricks' (leveinim) — with clarifying (libun) the halachah," etc.
That is, from the Generation of the Dispersion and from the exile of Egypt
they drew out the power of Torah she'b'al peh.
And at the time of Matan Torah,
אִיתָא בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג קצג, א)
it says in the holy Zohar (Zohar III 193a)
that they took from all the heavenly princes of the nations
And he expounded it from what is written (Devarim 33:2):

that is, Eisav, who is Se'ir,

And Yishmael gave the power of the words of Torah
"ram," exalted, indicates the aspect of Atika,

the aspect of Torah she'b'al peh,
(and this has been explained many times).
מֵהֶם הוֹצִיאוּ הַכֹּחַ תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה,
from them they drew out the power of Torah she'b'al peh,
And it says in Midrash Rabbah
because the nations of the world
who went to spend the festival of the bride's first visit
וְהוּא עַל פִּי שֶׁאָמְרוּ (פְּסָחִים פז, ב):
And this follows what Chazal say (Pesachim 87b):
"because He sent them to their mother's house," etc.
And this is as they say there in the Gemara:
"only so that converts would be added to them."
that some of them should actually convert;
rather, as the holy sefarim write,
it is to bring out the holy sparks
And as a consequence of this,
one from each nation is aroused
דְּאִיתָא (יַלְקוּט שִׁמְעוֹנִי, רֵישׁ שְׁמוּאֵל ב, רֶמֶז קמא)
although it says (Yalkut Shimoni, beginning of Shmuel II, remez 141)

and we said that this came about

through one of them having had relations with a Jewish woman
And so the holy sefarim write
that in every language there is
one word, or a few words,

is to bring out the holy sparks from them.

"the first-visit festival in her father's house" —
in the manner of the Gemara's exposition
שֶׁהָיָה מְקוֹם שׁוֹרֶשׁ תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה.
which was the place of the root of Torah she'b'al peh.

(רַעְיָא מְהֵימְנָא, זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג צח, א):
when the two Tablets were given

At first glance this is astonishing,
שֶׁהֲרֵי שָׁבוּעוֹת אֵינוֹ רַק יוֹם אֶחָד,
for Shavuos is only one day,
and the second Yom Tov of the Diaspora
is kept only out of doubt,
and in Eretz Yisrael they do not keep at all
the second Yom Tov of the Diaspora;
be alluded to in the Name Havayah?
But this appears to lend support
that there are two days of Shavuos:
from the side of Torah she'b'al peh,
in which the primordial light was revealed —
the dew of Atika, Toras chesed —
the sixth is the time of Matan Torah,
as it was in the original Thought.
וּשְׁבִיעִי הוּא זְמַן מַתַּן תּוֹרָה שֶׁבִּכְתָב,
And the seventh is the time of the giving of Torah she'b'chsav,
which is from the side of Gevurah;
and it is the letter Vav,
And so it is written in the holy Zohar

and from it there enter into a person's mouth

שֶׁזָּכַרְנוּ; זֹהַר חֵלֶק ב פא, א).

שֶׁהוּא עִיקַּר וְשׁוֹרֶשׁ תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה;
which is the essence and root of Torah she'b'al peh;

what is brought in the holy Zohar

in which there is already some measure of graspability.
as it was in the Thought, to be created;

And although in the Introduction to the Tikkunim it says

and when it was taken from Gevurah

that Torah she'b'chsav is from the side of Gevurah

וּכְמוֹ שֶׁמּוּבָא בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ הַנִּזְכָּר לְמַעְלָה;

וְזֶה מִימִינוֹ אֵשׁ דָּת לָמוֹ (דְּבָרִים לג, ב).
and this is "from His right hand, a fiery law for them" (Devarim 33:2).

it is the Torah that makes him boil,
That is, the giving to Yisrael

when the primordial light hidden within it is revealed —

From the side of Hashem Yisbarach,

as is known, the Clouds of Glory and the well too

corresponds to Yitzchak Avinu, alav hashalom,

Hakadosh Baruch Hu with their own eyes."
הוּא נֶגֶד יַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם,

the threefold one among the Avos,
the aspects of the three holy Avos,

And in line with this purpose one may say

the rectification of the three aspects mentioned above.

in order to refine the three traits mentioned above

וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה בָּאִים בְּיוֹם הַחֲמִשִּׁים
And through this they come, on the fiftieth day,
to the shining forth of the aspect of the supernal Shabbos,
which is the source of the flow of kedushah
they had not yet received the mitzvah of Shabbos
until after the splitting of the Sea,
with the Shabbos given at Marah (Sanhedrin 56b);
and it turns out that there were from then
until the sixth day of Sivan,
the fiftieth day from the Exodus,
to prepare the purity of their souls,
since they were missing the first Shabbos
for they had not yet been commanded concerning it.
Moshe Rabbeinu, alav hashalom, saw fit
to add one more day on his own,
so that Matan Torah would be
so that on this Shabbos there would be completed

מַה דְּאִיָּיר דְּהַאי שַׁתָּא עַבּוּרֵי עַבְּרוּהוּ,

And it was all for the purpose mentioned above:

so that they would also have the seventh Shabbos
to complete the purity of their souls,
בְּשַׁבָּת נִיתְּנָה תּוֹרָה לְיִשְׂרָאֵל (שַׁבָּת פו, ב).
the Torah was given to Yisrael on Shabbos (Shabbos 86b).

יֵשׁ סֶמֶךְ גָּדוֹל לְיוֹם טוֹב שֵׁנִי
there is strong support for the second Yom Tov
even according to the holy Torah.
And with this one also understands
the words of the Raya Mehemna in Parshas Emor
דִּתְרֵין יוֹמִין דְּשָׁבוּעוֹת אִינּוּן י׳ ו׳,
"the two days of Shavuos are Yud and Vav;
the Two Loaves, of Hei and Hei."
For seemingly there is no relevance at all
to the second day of Shavuos
בִּזְמַן שֶׁהָיוּ מְקַדְּשִׁים עַל פִּי הָרְאִיָּה,
at the time when they sanctified the month by sighting,
since it stems only from the custom of
the second Yom Tov of the Diaspora.
But according to our words above,
it has a great root in the Torah,
מִפְּנֵי שֶׁבֶּאֱמֶת הָיָה אָז בְּאוֹתוֹ הַיּוֹם
because in truth on that very day there was then
the actual Matan Torah, in revelation,
from the side of man's preparation.
וְהוּא מְרַמֵּז עַל בְּחִינַת תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה,
And it alludes to the aspect of Torah she'b'al peh,
which comes from the side of the recipient's preparation.

And with this one can also explain
the answer of the Magen Avraham
in the name of the Asarah Maamaros,
that it comes to allude for us
to the second Yom Tov of the Diaspora;
וְהַיְינוּ עִנְיַן הִתְיַיסְּדוּת תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה
and this is the matter of the founding of Torah she'b'al peh,
which comes in actuality, in revelation,
from the side of the recipient's preparation.
And it says in the Raya Mehemna, Parshas Naso
"The hidden things belong to Hashem our God" —
אִינּוּן י׳ ה׳, דְּאִינּוּן יִרְאָה וְאַהֲבָה;
"these are Yud Hei, which are fear and love;
and the revealed things — these are Vav Hei,"
that is, the Torah and the mitzvah,
And to this the letter Yud alludes,

שֶׁאוֹת י׳ עַל שֵׁם הַמַּחֲשָׁבָה נֶאֶמְרָה.
that the Yud is said on account of the thought.
